main_text.p: necesse est, vt physicus practicus ex subiecto suo catholico faciat haec duo, marem & foeminam, per debitam separationem.
main_text.head: COSMOLOGIA SACRA.5
main_text.p: I. Cosmologia sacra est pars physicae de na-tura mundi, petita ex sacris literis.

10II. Mundus est systema ex coelo & terra, & quae his continentur, pulcherrime constans. Haec definitio sumta est ex Gen. 1. v. 1. Et ita quidem vox mundi sumitur generaliter pro tota rerum creatarum vniuersitate: quo pertinet illa appellatio mundi apud Aristotelem, 15τὸ πᾶν [?] τὸ ὅλον. Specialiter etiam accipitur nunc pro terra 2. Pet. 3. v. 6. Ioh. 1. v. 9. nunc pro [illegible, ~6 letters] & depravatione, quae per peccatum introducta est in hunc mundum inferiorem 1. Ioh. 2. v. 16. nunc pro ipsis hominibus, iisque vel omnibus Rom. 5. v. 12. vel fidelibus Ioh. 3. v. 16. c. 17. 20v. 23. 24. vel infidelibus Ioh. 1. v. 10. 1. Ioh. 5. v. 19. Prima, eaque generalissima significatio, huius est loci.
main_text.head: III. In mundo spectantur principia & affectiones.
main_text.p: 25IV. Principia mundi sunt externa, vel interna. Principia externa sunt efficiens & finis, interna, materia & forma. Efficiens mundi est solus Deus, Pater, Filius & Spiritus sanctus. Gen. 1. v. 1. Pfal. 33. v. 6. & 104. v. 30. Iob. 9. v. 8. Ioh. 1. v. 3. 1. Cor. 8. v. 6. Hebr. 1. v. 2. Est, inquam, efficiens tum procreans, tum conseruans. Procreans; quia omnia produxit, & quidem partim per κτίσιν [?], i. e. creationem ex nihilo; partim per ποίησιν [?], id est, facturam; 30partim per πλάσιν [?], id est, figurationem. Primo modo creauit angelos, coelum, terram & animam hominis: secundo, herbas, stellas, aues, pisces & bestias terrestres: 35tertio, corpus Adami & Euae. Gen. 1. & 2. Deinde Deus est

page.notes: Margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are line references in the left margin. Greek in the first Greek phrase of section II is partly doubtful; the second Greek word of section II is too faint to read, so it is marked illegible. The Greek words in section IV (κτίσιν, ποίησιν, πλάσιν) are uncertain and marked [?]. Dark edge marks at the far left belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. The woodcut initial C is joined to "osmologia". The ct ligature in "practicus" is read as ct.
